items.review_rationale: Verified Iverson bracket expression of the numerical Kronecker delta for two elements of the same set.

references.context: Numerical value 1 when predicate of equality is true and 0 otherwise.

references.disposition: The underlying equality predicate has no new mathematical structure.

items.review_rationale: Verified bipartiteness via disjoint partition of the vertices with every edge crossing between opposite parts.

references.context: Every unordered pair belonging to the edge set has one endpoint in each vertex part.

references.disposition: The bipartition condition does not require nonempty vertex parts.
